name: Institute for Minimal Access Surgical Sciences
description: Surgical research at IMASS, University of Manitoba: clinical trials, surgical simulation, and research with Indigenous communities.
headline: Advancing surgical care - through research and simulation.
intro: We bring clinical research and surgical simulation together to improve patient care and the way surgeons learn.

researchAreas.title: Clinical research
researchAreas.text: Investigating surgical outcomes, bariatric care, and the factors that shape patients’ experiences and recovery.

researchAreas.title: Surgical simulation
researchAreas.text: Developing training models and studying surgical skill acquisition with eye tracking, simulation, and emerging technologies.

researchAreas.title: Research with Indigenous communities
researchAreas.text: Exploring Indigenous experiences of bariatric care and collaborative approaches to healing, wellness, and ethical surgical research.
